Class ManagedArray

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<Object>
java.util.AbstractList<Object>
java.util.ArrayList<Object>

org.springframework.beans.factory.support.ManagedArray
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, Iterable<Object>, Collection<Object>, List<Object>, RandomAccess, SequencedCollection<Object>, BeanMetadataElement, Mergeable
public class ManagedArray extends ManagedList<Object>
用于托管数组元素的标签集合类，其中可能包含运行时 Bean 引用（需解析为 Bean 对象）。
